recommendations.title: Break Circular Dependencies
recommendations.description: Found 22 dependency cycle(s). Circular dependencies make the codebase hard to test, refactor, and reason about. Start by extracting shared interfaces or introducing an event system to decouple the most entangled modules.

recommendations.title: Refactor God Classes
recommendations.description: Found 290 oversized classes. The worst offender is `Email` in `app/Entities/Email/Email.php` with 109 methods. Consider extracting responsibilities into dedicated service classes.

recommendations.title: Fix Layer Violations
recommendations.description: Found 21 architectural layer violations. Lower layers (Models, Repositories) should not depend on higher layers (Controllers, Views). Introduce dependency inversion or event dispatching.

recommendations.title: Reduce Coupling on Bottleneck Files
recommendations.description: The file `tests/Support/EntityRegistryCacheWarmup.php` has the highest betweenness centrality (0.0011), meaning changes to it affect the most other files. Consider breaking it into smaller, more focused modules.

recommendations.title: Review Potentially Dead Code
recommendations.description: Found 543 files with no incoming dependencies. These exclude files already classified as runtime entry candidates, so the remaining list is a stronger signal for potentially unused code.

recommendations.title: Audit Runtime Entry Surfaces
recommendations.description: Found 986 files that look like runtime entrypoints or loader-driven modules. Consider encoding these patterns in policy or plugins if they represent stable framework conventions.

recommendations.title: Triage External Analyzer Findings
recommendations.description: Imported 243 findings from external tools: 243 security-oriented and 0 quality-oriented. Use the archived raw artifacts for tool-specific remediation details.
